about: The laptop's Claude Code stops listing opus, the model sign-off's tier (mid: claude-sonnet-5-5) maps to, so Agent Manager refuses the spawn for its model, a refusal that cannot pass until something is fixed. The run must stop at sign_off with no run of the step's cap spent (its one attempt stays open, so the walker counts none against the cap), and stay stopped (JP-183).

checks.check: a run started for the ticket
the run stopped at the step

stopped.reason: needs a fix (bad-model): agent-manager: model "opus" is not one claude lists; it lists default, fable, sonnet, haiku. Fix: name a model Agent Manager lists: fix graphs/tiers.yaml or the `models` map in graphs/bindings/agent-manager/binding.json, then rerun graphs/tools/compile_graphs.py. The run goes on by itself once the fix reaches the laptop, or resume it with runner.py resume --run r-1fd87c73e638. It used no run of the step's cap.
